```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Install packages if you haven't already
# install.packages(c("rvest", "tidyverse"))

library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)

# Define the target URL
# url <- "https://houstonhealth.org"
url <- "https://www.houstonhealth.org/services/pollen-mold/houston-pollen-mold-count-thursday-october-292026"


# Read the HTML page
html_content <- read_html(url)

# Get all webpage text as a single string to parse with regex
page_text <- html_content %>% html_text()

#   Summaries

# Accurate extraction using regular expressions
extract_metric <- function(text, category) {
  # Regex to find the category and pull the next two distinct words/numbers
  pattern <- paste0(category, "\\s*\\n?\\s*([A-Za-z]+)\\s*\\n?\\s*([0-9,]+)")
  matches <- str_match(text, pattern)
  
  tibble(
    Category = category,
    Status   = matches[1, 2],
    Value    = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", matches[1, 3]))
  )
}

# Run the extraction for each primary group
tree_summary  <- extract_metric(page_text, "TREE POLLEN")
weed_summary  <- extract_metric(page_text, "WEED POLLEN")
grass_summary <- extract_metric(page_text, "GRASS POLLEN")
mold_summary  <- extract_metric(page_text, "MOLD SPORES")

# Combine into a clean summary table
summary_table <- bind_rows(tree_summary, weed_summary, grass_summary, mold_summary)


# 1. Scrape the detailed list items (contains the raw breakdown strings)
raw_list_items <- html_content %>% 
  html_nodes("li") %>% 
  html_text(trim = TRUE)

# 2. Filter and structure the data using text processing
pollen_data <- tibble(raw_text = raw_list_items) %>%
  # Filter only rows that contain the separator ":"
  filter(str_detect(raw_text, ":")) %>%
  # Split the text into Type and Count components
  separate(raw_text, into = c("Type", "Count"), sep = ":\\s*") %>%
  # Idiots.  Some sort of non-printing trash in the fields
  mutate(Count = str_remove(Count, "\\W")) |> 
  # Convert counts to integers (removing any formatting commas)
  mutate(Count = as.numeric(str_remove_all(Count, ","))) %>%
  # get rid of superfluous lines
  filter_out(str_detect(Type, "Call Center|Emergency"))

  # Add tree, weed, or mold designation

pollen_data <- pollen_data |> 
  mutate(
    # Create a cumulative sum group ID based on occurrences of "Other"
    group_id = lag(cumsum(str_detect(Type, "Other")), default=0),
    
    # Assign the Class based on the group ID
    Class = case_when(
      group_id == 0 ~ "Tree",
      group_id == 1 ~ "Weed",
      TRUE          ~ "Mold"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-group_id) # Remove the temporary helper column

# Print out the structured table of non-zero counts
pollen_data %>% 
  filter(Count > 0) %>% 
  print(n = Inf)

```
